title: Global convexity of the Bernstein basis square-sum
source: Gonska-Rasa-Rusu, arXiv:1401.7908v1, Conjectures 3.2-3.4; Lemma 3.5 already proves the minimum
proof_attribution: Known convexity result: Geno Nikolov (2014), Corollary 4 of arXiv:1402.6539v1; separate Parseval-based proof by Ioan Gavrea and Mircea Ivan (2014), doi:10.1016/j.amc.2014.05.003. This artifact supplies a finite Fourier formalization, not a novelty claim.
bridge: finite_average_identity proves equality to the original defining square-sum for every n and every real x; no alternate formula is assumed
positive_coefficient_identity: Universally derived in paper section 4; independently checked by exact integer coefficients for n=0,...,32. Not used as an assumption or theorem in Lean.
outcome: The exact Bernstein basis square-sum is convex on the entire real line for every natural n; symmetry, monotonicity, and the sharp midpoint value are also proved.
novelty: Known convexity theorem (2014), independently formalized via finite Fourier averaging. Related327181/327182 are included as corollaries, not separate outcomes.
